ideas.pitch: An intelligent queuing and inventory reservation system for electric vehicle battery swapping stations to minimize wait times and balance grid draw.
ideas.title: SwapQueue AI: Predictive Battery Swapping Station Load Balancer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles Battery Smart's core operational pain point of station congestion and battery availability using algorithms, matching a proven pattern of energy efficiency software wins.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight telemetry analysis tool that reads EV battery management system (BMS) data streams to flag failing cells before thermal events occur.
ideas.problem_statement: Technology-driven solutions and automation in electric mobility
ideas.title: CellHealth: Edge-AI Battery Degradation & Thermal Runaway Early Warning
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering and safety-critical machine learning tailored explicitly to EV infrastructure, appealing strongly to battery industry judges.

ideas.pitch: A physical hardware prototype using microcontrollers and RFID readers to simulate automated, keyless battery swapping lockers for delivery fleets.
ideas.title: SmartSwap IoT: Automated RFID & Smart-Lock Station Kiosk Prototype
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an unusual physical build that stands out in a room full of standard web apps, leveraging a hardware-demo pattern proven at previous hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A routing dashboard optimized for electric two-wheelers that plans delivery sequences factoring in real-time battery state-of-charge and nearest swap station locations.
ideas.title: FleetRoute EV: Multi-Stop Range & Swapping Optimizer for Delivery Fleets
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate commercial bottleneck for B2B logistics fleets operating on Battery Smart infrastructure with a polished, working live map demo.

ideas.pitch: A C-based energy management program that coordinates solar input, local grid pricing, and charging schedules for battery swapping station hubs.
ideas.title: GridBuffer: V2G Swapping Station Energy Management System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact technical architecture of proven energy management winning entries, showcasing rigorous algorithmic resource allocation.
